channel.name: The Pragmatic Engineer
channel.description:
Interviews about software engineering, Big Tech and startups. Highly relevant for developers and engineering leaders, useful for those working in tech.

Writing The Pragmatic Engineer Newsletter (the #1 newsletter for software engineers) and the author of The Software Engineer's Guidebook

title: Building world-class engineering teams in the age of AI - The Pragmatic Summit
description:
With Thomas Dohmke (cofounder & CEO, Entire, previously CEO at GitHub) and Rajeev Rajan (CTO, Atlassian). 

More details in this accompanying article: https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/the-future-of-software-engineering-with-ai

Recorded at The Pragmatic Summit: https://www.pragmaticsummit.com

0:00 Intro
0:46 What an AI-native team looks like
5:08 How teams are actually using agents day-to-day
8:05 AI-native SDLC and internal coding agents
9:03 Distributed teams
12:57 How engineering, PM, and design roles are changing
18:32 What engineering leaders should do differently
22:32 Organizational resistance
24:01 Management in the agent era
28:33 Future predictions
